Continue the Arthas codebase refactoring. Working directory: /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G012_arthas

Nine rounds have been completed. Covered so far: classLoaderHash consistency, anonymous inner classes → lambdas (Comparator, Runnable, ThreadFactory, Handler), diamond-operator modernization, Collections.sort → list.sort, method extraction, unused import removal.

## Your task

### Step 1: Run a broad survey
```bash
# All remaining anonymous inner class sites
grep -rn "new Comparator\b\|new Runnable\b\|new ThreadFactory\b\|new \(Handler\|Callable\|ActionListener\)" \
  core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/ --include="*.java"

# All remaining raw-type generics (no diamond)
grep -rn "new [A-Z][a-zA-Z]*<[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*[,>]" \
  core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/ --include="*.java" | grep -v "//.*new " | head -60

# Unused Collections imports (to clean up after earlier sort removals)
grep -rn "import java.util.Collections" \
  core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/ --include="*.java"
```

### Step 2: Prioritize and apply
Focus on files **not yet touched** in rounds 1-9. Key unvisited areas:
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/command/monitor200/WatchCommand.java`
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/command/monitor200/TraceCommand.java`
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/command/monitor200/StackCommand.java`
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/command/monitor200/TimeTunnelCommand.java`
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/shell/` (sub-packages not yet covered)
- `core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/command/basic1000/` (beyond MBeanCommand)
- Any file the grep finds with anonymous classes

For each file read it fully, then apply:
1. Anonymous `new Comparator<T>(){...}` → lambda or `Comparator.comparing(...)`
2. Anonymous `new Runnable(){...}` → `() -> {...}` or method reference
3. Anonymous `new ThreadFactory(){...}` → `r -> { Thread t = ...; t.setDaemon(true); return t; }`
4. Anonymous `new Handler<X>(){...}` → `event -> ...`
5. Raw-type `new Foo<A,B>()` → `new Foo<>()`
6. `import java.util.Collections` — remove only if no remaining usages in the file after changes

### Step 3: Check for unused `import java.util.Comparator`
After converting anonymous Comparators to simple lambdas (not using `Comparator.comparing`), the import may be unused. Remove it if so.

### Constraints
- JDK 8 compatible — lambdas yes, streams only if already present, no new var/record/etc.
- No logic changes, only syntax/style modernization.
- Do NOT touch test files, `target/`, or documentation files.
- Run `./mvnw -pl arthas-vmtool install -q` then `./mvnw -pl core -am test -q` after all changes.
- The pre-existing failure `ObjectViewTest.testDate` (timezone flake) is expected — ignore it.
- Report: files changed, specific changes per file, final test result line (e.g. "Tests run: 307, Failures: 1").
